name: Labeled Sample Compression of Full Cube
proof: On the full cube all binary reconstruction functions are proper, so LSC equals proper LSC. Apply the counting lower bound and the stable block-construction upper bound proved in the database-owned proper labeled full-cube value proof; its counting estimate also proves linear order. Stability is not assumed for this lower bound; the exact stable value must not be substituted for the ordinary value without a proof.
references: Database-owned proper labeled full-cube value proof.
